profile.name: Agent Workspace Cursor Setup
profile.description: Cursor setup assets for global agents, Playwright MCP, compatibility permissions, and optional skills. Auto Review remains IDE-managed.

notes: Primary workflow: apply Cursor setup to the global Cursor agents, skills, MCP, and permissions files.
Select Auto Review manually in Cursor Settings > Agents > Run Mode; Agent Workspace does not inspect or write undocumented Cursor runtime state.
User Rules remain manually managed in Cursor Settings; this setup does not write a global User Rules file.
Project rules, project MCP, project agents, project ignore files, and AGENTS.md are never written by the global setup flow.
Legacy sandbox JSON is compatibility-only and intentionally absent from the normal app workflow.
Never store credentials or private configuration in workspace templates.
